description: This file defines the class InlineBlockEntityOperations, which manages entity events related to inline blocks in Drupal's layout builder module, including handling creation, deletion, and cleanup of inline block entities and their usage.

classes.name: InlineBlockEntityOperations
classes.description: A utility class for managing entity events related to inline blocks within Drupal's layout builder, including cleanup, creation, and deletion of inline block entities and their usage tracking.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: removeUnusedForEntityOnSave
methods.description: Removes unused inline blocks associated with an entity when it is saved, considering revisions and default storage usage.

methods.name: getRemovedBlockIds
methods.description: Determines which inline block IDs have been removed from an entity by comparing original and current sections.

methods.name: handleEntityDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a parent entity is deleted by removing associated inline block usage.

methods.name: handlePreSave
methods.description: Pre-save handler for an entity, managing inline block duplication, revision creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: deleteBlocksAndUsage
methods.description: Deletes specified inline block entities and their usage records.

methods.name: removeUnused
methods.description: Removes a batch of unused inline blocks up to a specified limit.

methods.name: getBlockIdsForRevisionIds
methods.description: Retrieves block entity IDs corresponding to given revision IDs.

methods.name: saveInlineBlockComponent
methods.description: Saves an inline block component, updating usage records accordingly.
